messages:
maya: Support flagged many "payload too large" reports. SDKs just throw 413 and users pile into support. Can we emit a compact advisory that includes an estimated units header so clients can make smarter tradeoffs?
aj: Propose `X-Embed-Units: dims=512,bytes=180000,units=3,split=3x170` plus `X-Embed-Split-Latency-ms: 120`. Advisory-only; not a policy. Hosted first, Dedicated opt-in.

kevin: Important: Dedicated tenants expect deterministic enforcement. Advisory must be opt-in per-tenant (admin toggle) and never expose billing or exact quota thresholds. Estimates only.

maya: Telemetry plan: emit `embed.advice.sent` with tags (tenant, route, rollout) and `embed.advice.applied` when SDKs take the suggestion. Also track `ingest.request_multiplier` to measure ops impact.

sara: Rollout: hosted canary 5% for 7 days, monitor adoption + ingress spike; expand to 25% if stable. SDK flag `embed.auto_apply_advice=false` by default.

natalie: UX note: SDK should show a short dev-level warning first and only auto-split when `units_after_split <= units_before * 1.2`. Also prefer sequential splits if `split_latency_ms` indicates parallel is worse.

ops-bot: Watch metrics during canary: `ingest.queue_depth`, `ingest.shed_rate`, `ingest.e2e_p95_ms`. Alert if queue_depth > baseline*4.

aj: Header format final suggestion: `X-Embed-Advice: dims=512;bytes=180000;units=3;plan=3x170;est_split_units=4;est_parallel_ms=120`. Use semicolon delim for easier parsing. Version later with `X-Embed-Advice-v1`.

kevin: Add unit & integration tests: header present only when tenant flag true for hosted; suppressed otherwise. Also audit when Dedicated admin flips opt-in.

maya: Console: add a small tile under Embeddings showing advice_sent vs advice_applied, and an automated support blurb: "If you see Payload Too Large, split vectors into N of size M or enable SDK auto-splitting."

sara: I'll file CON ticket and create two alerts: 1) adoption concern if advice_sent/requests > 5% and advice_applied < 10% for 7d; 2) ops concern if ingest.queue_depth spikes >4x.

aj: I'll implement the advisory header behind a feature flag and emit `embed.advice.sent`. PR incoming today.

kevin: SGTM. Ensure no tenant-specific limits or PII in headers.
natalie: SDK team will add opt-in flag and UI warning. We'll do canary telemetry to report advice_applied.

console-bot: Ticket PLAT-EMBED-6120 created: "Advisory units header + SDK split canary". Linked CON-201. Assignees: aj (impl), kevin (security review), sara (rollout).

maya: Decision summary recorded: 1) Emit advisory header on hosted canary with dims/bytes/units/plan/est_parallel_ms. 2) SDKs default to warning; auto-apply behind opt-in + cost guard. 3) Console metrics & alerts added. 4) Dedicated admin opt-in only. Closing thread.
